d.title: Pokemon: Pikachu no Fuyuyasumi (2001)
d.jp: ピカチュウのふゆやすみ2001
syn: We are the Pichu Brothers - Balloon Disturbance
d.synopsis: Pikachu's Winter Vacations are three series of videos, each composed of several Pikachu shorts. All shorts deal with winter and Christmas. This is the third and last series and contains Delibird's Dilemma, Snorlax Snowman & Trouble in Big Town.
